headline: European Natural Gas Surges to One-Week High Amid Middle East Conflict
summary: European natural gas prices rose to a one-week high on Monday as accelerating conflict in the Gulf raised concerns over energy supply stability.
why: Natural gas is a crucial energy benchmark in Europe, influencing industrial production costs and household heating prices across the continent.

impacts.name: Dutch TTF Natural Gas
impacts.why: Natural gas prices surged due to escalating geopolitical conflict in the Gulf region.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Geopolitical conflict in the Gulf accelerated supply disruption fears, driving natural gas futures higher.
